impact.text: Campaigns may distribute rewards below the minimum intended threshold.

precondition_sources.text: The gross newCampaign.amount passes the minimum reward validation before fees are deducted.
Protocol fees are deducted from the campaign amount, so the net amount applied to participants is less than the gross amount.

intent_sources.text: The net reward per hour after fees applied to participants must be at or above the intended minimum threshold.
Minimum reward validation must be performed on the net amount after fees are computed.
